coverText: Navy door letters on a yellow sheet. The only other printed text is "1/6" at the bottom right, next to a small flag. No folder title is printed.

layout.orientation: Upright, with the sheet mark 1/6 at the bottom right.
layout.note: The middle and right columns are five cells. The left column is four taller cells over the same height, so U sits a little below L and D, and Y sits a little above P and F. Top row R K A aligns. Bottom row Z Q J aligns.
